Payout of 15 July is short ₹20,108.59.
The bank credited ₹3,80,838.97 against an expected ₹4,00,947.56. 20 orders sit in this payout. No refund, chargeback or payment in the gateway ledger accounts for the difference, so the cause is not yet identified.
Suggested action: request the gateway's own breakdown for this payout, and check for a dispute debited but not yet reported.
